title: Night Audit Posting Standard for Room and Room Tax on Guest Folios
content:
**Standard.** For every night actually stayed, the night audit of an Ashbury hotel posts to the Guest Folio one room line equal to the reservation's nightly rate and one room tax line equal to that rate multiplied by the reservation's tax rate, rounded to the cent, both carrying the stay night as their business date. Nights paid with points or Free Night Awards carry a nightly rate of $0.00 and post no room or room tax lines. Room lines are posted only to a folio whose status is open. A night has at most one room line and one room tax line; a second line with the same charge code and business date is a duplicate posting. Nights after the actual check-out date are never posted.

## Posting pattern for one night

| Night | Room line | Room tax line | Business date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Night stayed, paid in cash or by card | The reservation's nightly rate | That rate multiplied by the reservation's tax rate, rounded to the cent | The stay night |
| Night paid with points or a Free Night Award | None (nightly rate $0.00) | None | — |
| Night after the actual check-out date | Never posted | Never posted | — |

## Status of the folio

Room lines are posted only while the folio's status is open. A settled or reopened folio receives no room lines.

## Duplicate test

Two room lines with the same business date on one folio, or two room tax lines with the same business date, mean the second is a duplicate posting: a night carries at most one of each.

## Worked figure (hypothetical reservation)

A reservation at a nightly rate of $189.00 with a tax rate of 12.75% posts, for each night stayed, a room line of $189.00 and a room tax line of $24.10 ($189.00 multiplied by 12.75% is $24.0975, rounded to the cent). Over three nights stayed the folio carries three room lines and three room tax lines, one of each per stay night. If the guest checks out after two of the three nights, the third night is never posted.
